children: ICICI Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:ICICIBANK) saw deposit growth slow while advances rose sharply and excess liquidity awaits deployment, even as an API breach in Oct caused ~$2m in unauthorized transfers linked to two Mumbai non-bank lenders; mutual funds boosted holdings into Sept 2026.
: ICICI Bank ADR (ICICIBANK): deposits growth slowed to 17% y/y from 27.1%; advances up 30% y/y (24.1% ex-FCNR(B)). Bank holds excess liquidity and plans to deploy into new lending.
: API breach enabled over 700 unauthorized instant transfers from ICICIBANK accounts on Oct 8–9, totaling about $2 million; transfers tied to two Mumbai non-bank lenders; police filed a complaint
: In Sept 2026, Indian mutual funds bought ICICIBANK ADRs worth Rs 2,689 crore; total mutual fund holdings in ICICIBANK stood at Rs 1,96,008 crore per Aug–Sept 2026 disclosures.
